channel.title: Finality
channel.description: Finality reports crypto news: protocol upgrades, network incidents, exchange and stablecoin developments, regulation and the projects shaping blockchain.

item.title: Fairshake targets 32 House races as crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House incumbents for midterm support, with six set for $1 million each, as the stalled CLARITY Act pushes crypto policy fights into the next Congress.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates as crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake will back 32 House incumbents, including six with $1 million each, as the stalled CLARITY Act shifts the industry's focus toward November's elections.

item.title: Payward links SGB Net to Kraken Prime for 24/7 settlement
item.description: Payward integrated SGB Net for instant, 24/7 institutional dollar funding in selected Asian and Gulf markets, linking bank settlement to Kraken Prime liquidity.

item.title: Read the Ethereum Deposit Log Before You Switch Chains
item.description: An Ethereum receipt proves contract execution, not Polygon credit: identify the bridge event, verify its emitter and arguments, then check the destination chain before switching.

item.title: Ethereum Foundation puts zkAPI payment system on mainnet
item.description: Ethereum Foundation and Open Anonymity put zkAPI on mainnet, using zero-knowledge proofs to separate metered API payments from prompts while leaving IP and content exposed.

item.title: Why an imbalanced LP deposit moves with the market
item.description: An imbalanced deposit starts with uneven token exposure, but pool pricing, range boundaries and later trades determine how that exposure changes as prices move.

item.title: A Token Blacklist Can Stop a Bridge Redemption at Either End
item.description: A token blacklist can stop a bridge deposit, burn, or final release at different contract calls; tracing the failing transfer identifies the actual redemption path.

item.title: Why Polygon PoS Bridge Withdrawals Take Hours
item.description: A Polygon PoS withdrawal waits for a validator checkpoint on Ethereum, then a separate exit call; checkpoint cadence, Ethereum inclusion and user action set the total time.

item.title: Coinbase Clearing completes its CFTC-regulated derivatives stack
item.description: Coinbase Clearing LLC is now a CFTC-registered clearing organization, letting Coinbase clear fully collateralized futures, options and swaps within its US derivatives stack.

item.title: Three Checks for a Polygon PoS Withdrawal That Is Waiting
item.description: A Polygon PoS withdrawal has a burn, a validator checkpoint and an Ethereum exit; these three checks show which stage is waiting and what action remains.

item.title: When an Ethereum Deposit to Manta Pacific Is Stuck
item.description: A mined Ethereum deposit can still be waiting for Manta Pacific to execute its cross-chain message; trace the receipt, destination credit and token mapping before retrying.

item.title: Convert Base Airdrops to Stablecoins at the Right Point
item.description: Turning a Base airdrop into USDC means checking the token, swapping through a liquid Base pool, and deciding whether to hold it onchain or withdraw it.

item.title: Tether-backed Utexo targets October USDT return to Bitcoin
item.description: Utexo plans to issue USDT on Bitcoin through RGB this month, reviving Tether’s original settlement network while keeping payment details off the public chain.

item.title: Fee-on-Transfer Bridge Deposits Need Balance-Delta Accounting
item.description: A bridge should credit the tokens its contract actually receives, then carry that measured amount through messaging, minting, and withdrawal accounting without overstating collateral.

item.title: Check a Base Token Before You Swap
item.description: Check the token contract, permissions, liquidity and sell path before swapping on Base; a familiar name or verified source code cannot establish that a token is safe.

item.title: What a Contract Energy Ratio Actually Controls
item.description: A contract energy ratio sets the caller’s share of TRON execution costs, but deployer limits and depleted Energy can shift the bill back to the caller.

item.title: How an Avalanche Treasury Should Set Swap Slippage
item.description: Set a swap’s minimum output from the treasury’s price and execution limits, then size orders against pool depth so volatility does not turn a quote into a blind fill.

item.title: Check Whether a Chart Export Preserves Timeframe and Zoom
item.description: A chart export preserves your analysis only if its candles, visible date range and zoom match the live view; check the axes and exported data before sharing.

item.title: Exact-output swaps need a fresh quote as pool state moves
item.description: Exact-output swaps fix the tokens received and solve backward for input, so traders refresh quotes as pool state shifts and keep a slippage cap on spend.

item.title: Compare Cross-Chain Swap Quotes by What Arrives
item.description: Compare cross-chain swap quotes by the amount that reaches your wallet after fees, destination swaps and execution changes, then weigh timing and settlement risk.
